hook: What happens to your brain when the clock drops below 6 seconds
text:
What happens to your brain when the clock drops below 6 seconds

Heart rate spikes to 140+ BPM.
Peripheral vision narrows into tunnel vision.
Conscious calculation shuts down.

Under extreme time trouble, only trained pattern recognition survives.
